value.rationale: Union semilattice frames and the distinction between arbitrary versus restricted valuations are prominent in the first-public 2025 work on associative modal undecidability. For their residual-relevance counterpart, cardinality is the natural orbit invariant under finite-set permutations, and ultimately periodic observation predicates are a canonical robust regular class. This theorem gives a sharp invariant-closure boundary under arbitrary implication nesting, an explicit finite quotient, and a depth-one obstruction; it is not a routine renaming, arbitrary finite slice, or general validity decision.
